vision.name: Krillin
vision.text: [Continuous]: Whenever a Setup enters play under your control, gain 2 stages. Whenever a Setup or Drill enters play under your control during combat, Rejuvenate 1 and banish the top card of your opponent's Life Deck. POWER: [Attack] 2: Energy attack. You may use this attack a second time this combat. DAMAGE: 5 life cards. HIT: Search your Life Deck or discard pile for a Setup or Drill and place it into play.
vision.note: full-art promo layout (815x1111); right edge reads HERO -> Main Personality; top stage is printed 1,000,100 (not a misread)
